claims.top_20: Integration coverage across secret scanning, repository/filesystem scanning, dependency metadata where an ecosystem is available, and semantic or generic SAST. It does not mean every scanner detects every vulnerability class.
claims.top_50: Detection catalog and baseline generic coverage. Ecosystem and semantic depth vary by language.
claims.platforms: Orchestrator portability and source/image target coverage are distinct from availability of every native scanner binary on every host.

core_scanners.name: Gitleaks
core_scanners.role: Git history and working-tree secret detection

core_scanners.name: Trivy
core_scanners.role: Vulnerabilities, misconfiguration, secrets, licenses, images and CycloneDX SBOM

core_scanners.name: Opengrep
core_scanners.role: Multi-language SAST with local, reviewable rules
